attr.title: Ends of the Earth 2
attr.desc: A 1998-2000 freeware RPG by Valkayree Productions, built with the OHRRPGCE engine. You play Atoch, youngest in a line of descendants dedicated to stopping the return of Caramawn, in this sequel to Ends of the Earth. Revisit the city of Concorde and choose from over 40 playable characters.
attr.inst: Engine only. You must provide EOTE2.RPG yourself. The game data is All Rights Reserved by Valkayree Productions and cannot be bundled. Download it from Castle Paradox's mirror and place it next to ohrrpgce-game before launching.
